audit.whatIsWrong: Row 6 gave two-plus items to Darius while whys[6], spikes[3] and the late paragraph all say Kayle flips the matchup there and explicitly credit it for the 54.29% win rate. Row 2 said Skill while whys[2] says to concede the wave.
audit.why: A dash-less juggernaut cannot reach a ranged Kayle at two items; conversely at level 3 Noxian Might plus stacked Hemorrhage beats anything melee Kayle has.
audit.corrected: Row 6 to Kayle at 7/10, row 2 to Darius at 3/10, both layers.

audit.why: spikes[] name Divine Ascent and Divine Judgment at 6, Starfire Spellblade with Nashor's at first item, and the two-item peak; the mirror audit already wrote the 160s ultimate cooldown into the shared fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, no mention that Decimate's blade heals him, and no mention that Noxian Guillotine's cooldown refreshes on a kill.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 and 16s at rank 5 — the longest cooldown in the matchup and the single largest safe-farming window Kayle gets. Decimate heals off champions hit by the blade, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades. Guillotine's refresh is why a kill near you snowballs into a second one.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], dosFull[2], dontsFull[1] and report[5] now carry 26s/16s, 9s, 120s, the Decimate heal and the refresh.
